mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_in_cents), 0) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{from} AND paid_at < #{to} AND status IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','COMPLETED')) AS totalRevenueCents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to}) AS totalOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product) AS totalProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE refund_status = 'APPROVED' AND paid_at >= #{from} AND paid_at < #{to}) AS refundCount, (SELECT COALESCE(AVG((quality_stars + logistics_stars + service_stars) / 3.0), 0) FROM review WHERE create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to}) AS avgRating, NULL AS monthlyRevenue, NULL AS unitsByProduct, NULL AS revenueTrend, NULL AS salesShareByProduct

SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, oi.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.paid_at >= #{from} AND o.paid_at < #{to} AND o.status IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','COMPLETED') GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.name ORDER BY units DESC

SELECT ${bucketExpr} AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(paid_in_cents), 0) AS cents FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{from} AND paid_at < #{to} AND status IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','COMPLETED') GROUP BY ${bucketExpr} ORDER BY bucket ASC
